# `delegation` — version 2.1

Source: `presets/delegation.satz`

## Purpose

Delegated access, the base: one identity per delegation. A delegation gives a team — or a
product, a service — access to a part of the organization's resources from an estate of
its own, beside this one. This pack is the half every delegation has, whatever is
delegated: an infrastructure project with the service account the team's pipelines run
as and the bucket its states live in, and the group whose members may act as that
account. WHAT is delegated is another pack's: folders
(`presets/delegated-folders.satz`), Google projects (`presets/delegated-projects.satz`),
each entry of which names the delegation whose account works in it.

ONE LIST. One entry of `delegations` is one identity:
{ name = "shop" estate_account_user_group = "gcp-shop-admins@example.com" }
bound in the estate, added with `satz add-entry`, or requested by the team as
`contributes_delegations` in a small pack of its own, checked with `satz check-request`
and vendored by pull request. A `name` is lowercase letters, digits and `-`, starting
with a letter.

PER DELEGATION. The infrastructure project `{customer_shortname}-deploy-<name>` in the
infrastructure folder, `google_folder.infra_folder`, beside the organization's own,
billed to the infrastructure billing account, with the APIs
of the entry's `apis`: the team's calls are billed to this project, so an API its
resources' calls need is asked for here. Inside it the account `svc-deploy-<name>` and
the state bucket `{customer_shortname}-deploy-<name>-state`, which the account may
write; the estate account user group reads the project and may act as the account —
that account only. On
the billing account the account holds the entry's `billing_roles` (`roles/billing.user`
unless the entry says more), on the organization `delegation_organization_roles` —
`roles/browser` and nothing else by default: an interface looks a folder up by its name
among its parent's folders, and that listing needs `resourcemanager.folders.list` on the
parent.

AN ENTRY THAT ASKS FOR MORE. `apis` and `billing_roles` are lists, and an entry that
states one states it whole: the six APIs below plus its own, `roles/billing.user` plus
its own.

WHAT THE WORKLOAD ESTATE READS. The interface `delegation-<name>`, taken to its
`interfaces/incoming/` folder: `infrastructure_project_id` (its infrastructure project),
`estate_account` and its account id `estate_account_id`, `state_bucket`,
`estate_account_user_group`, and what was delegated to the account beside its targets —
`delegated_billing_roles`, `delegated_apis` — which tell the workload's team what the
account holds; satz checks no role in a workload estate. `satz init --from` writes the workload estate from it, reading its estate
account (`svc_iac_account`, `infra_project_name`) and its state bucket by the folder's
name. Each target's own interface is taken beside it.

NO CLAIM. A delegation is an identity, not a control: this pack witnesses nothing.

## Use it

```
params {
  use_delegation = true

  // the pack's own defaults — copy only the lines you change
  delegations = []
  delegation_organization_roles = [ "roles/browser" ]
  delegation_group_roles = [
    "roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator",
    "roles/iam.serviceAccountUser",
  ]
}

use "presets/delegation.satz" when use_delegation
```

`use_delegation` is the gate: while it is falsy the pack contributes nothing — no resources, no params, no claims. It is declared by `estate_map`, and the estate's own binding wins.

**Needs from outside the pack:**

- `billing_account_infra` — declared by `estate_core`; use one of them alongside, or declare it in the estate.
- `customer_shortname` — declared by `estate_core`; use one of them alongside, or declare it in the estate.
- `default_region` — declared by `estate_core`; use one of them alongside, or declare it in the estate.

## Exports

Outputs of the HCL code and values of the interfaces under `interfaces/outgoing/` in every estate that uses this pack: a `core` export is carried by every interface, another one by its own interface and every interface that uses it. An interface a pack declares is common: every project's folder carries it.

| interface | output | value | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `delegation-{each.name}` | `infrastructure_project_id` | `"{customer_shortname}-deploy-{each.name}"` | The delegation's infrastructure project: the team's plans are billed to it |
| `delegation-{each.name}` | `estate_account` | `"svc-deploy-{each.name}@{customer_shortname}-deploy-{each.name}.iam.gserviceaccount.com"` | The service account the workload estates run as |
| `delegation-{each.name}` | `estate_account_id` | `"svc-deploy-{each.name}"` | The estate account's id, the part of its address before the `@`: a workload estate's `svc_iac_account` |
| `delegation-{each.name}` | `state_bucket` | `"{customer_shortname}-deploy-{each.name}-state"` | The bucket the workload estates keep their states in |
| `delegation-{each.name}` | `estate_account_user_group` | `"{each.estate_account_user_group}"` | The group whose members may act as the account |
| `delegation-{each.name}` | `account_group_roles` | `delegation_group_roles` | What that group holds on the account |
| `delegation-{each.name}` | `billing_account` | `billing_account_infra` | The billing account a new project is linked to, and a budget is created on |
| `delegation-{each.name}` | `delegated_billing_roles` | `each.billing_roles` | The roles the account holds on the billing account |
| `delegation-{each.name}` | `delegated_apis` | `each.apis` | The APIs enabled on the delegation's infrastructure project |

`delegation-{each.name}` is written once per entry of `delegations`, named by the entry's `name`, and each is one project's own interface, not a common one.

## List params

What a project may add to this pack's lists, through `contributes_<param>` in a file the estate uses after a reviewed pull request; `satz check-request` checks such a file.

| list | key | fields | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `delegations` | `name` | `name` matching `[a-z][a-z0-9-]*`, `estate_account_user_group` matching `[^@: ]+@[^@: ]+`, `apis`, `billing_roles` | A delegation: its name, the address of the group that may act as its account, the APIs of its infrastructure project and its roles on the billing account |

## Claims

_None — this pack proves no control by itself._
